title: Apparent calibration or data processing issue reported (with Libre/Blucon)
symptom: The app sometimes seems to get into a dormant state, especially at low glucose levels, and does not move from a level (e.g., showing 77 when actual blood glucose is 33). Calibration entries at low values are rejected as out of range.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Developers suggest it may be a calibration slope mismatch or that raw sensor data is staying the same, but they cannot reproduce it and consider it unlikely an algorithm issue.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Suggestions include calibrating on stable values that are low-normal and highish-normal, and resetting all calibrations (Stop Sensor > Don't Stop, Just Reset all Calibrations) as a workaround.
settings_changed: Stop Sensor > Don't Stop, Just Reset all Calibrations
evidence_quote: The main reason this issue doesn't have any real way to resolve it is that what is being reported doesn't make any sense, hasn't been reported before and may well be an issue out of our control. We certainly don't have any way to reproduce it.
